## Checklist

- [ ] Branch follows `<prefix>/<issue-number>-<short-description>` and is not `main`
- [ ] The change is limited to the scope of the linked Issue
- [ ] Every acceptance criterion is implemented and covered by a test
- [ ] Tests, lint and build pass locally; required CI checks are green
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, `.env` files or personal data are included
- [ ] Architecture and Accepted ADRs are respected, or a deviation is documented in an ADR
- [ ] Documentation is updated for any behaviour change
- [ ] I reviewed my own diff for debug code, unrelated changes and generated files
- [ ] I understand that only a human code owner approves and merges this Pull Request
